rationale: Aggregator enumerating all 11 licensed ME banks — mine once as the actor list, not a continuous signal feed.
Authoritative CBCG register of licensed banks/PSPs; mine as canonical actor list, parent cbcg.me covers ongoing monitoring.
Valuable ME payments-startup enumeration but Tracxn is registration/paywall gated; human must clear access.
MFIC member/board list gives indirect leadership signals; deep-link unresolved, re-check at mfic.me root.
Single individual LinkedIn profile — personal data, login-walled, not a durable monitorable source.
Bankar.me is a live ME banking/finance portal and its bank directory anchors the actor map; on-sector and productive.
Vijesti economy section: highest-value national outlet for contested bank personnel and org-change reporting.
Pobjeda economy desk carries appointment notices and AGM/board reports; needed for triangulation against Vijesti.
CdM high-volume portal, fast on press-release appointment and branch-reorganisation news.
Public broadcaster economy feed: durable, unpaywalled record of CBCG and bank leadership appointments.
Portal Analitika 'Abiznis' is a standing business vertical with finance/corporate-management coverage.
Ekonomist.me is ME's fintech/payments-focused business magazine — directly on-sector and rarely duplicated.
Antena M economy section, interview-heavy; likely venue for first-person accounts from departing bankers.
Borba is early on patronage/appointment claims but politically aligned and low credibility; tripwire only.
Standard.co.me adds only redundancy over stronger portals; value unproven.
Aktuelno.me economy rubric is a secondary breadth source largely duplicating CdM/Vijesti.
IN4S is a partisan low-credibility portal; every claim needs corroboration, so not worth registry space.
Local portal is the only level that reports branch closures and small-town bank staff cuts — real org-change signal.
Podgorica city portal; occasional head-office/branch items but thin and overlapping national coverage.
MOM media-ownership database: mine once to complete and bias-weight the ME outlet list, then archive.
Single bank's Facebook page is one actor's channel and a mirror layer; belongs under the bank, not a standalone source.
CRPS/eFirma company register publishes legal-representative changes; portal likely gated/unstable, clear access first.
Beneficial-ownership register reveals control changes behind banks/PSPs; AML register access typically restricted.
Official Gazette is the authoritative, searchable feed of appointments/dismissals and banking by-laws.
Commercial legislation catalogue with updated-regulations feed; commercial access terms and reachability unclear.
CBCG leadership page is a sub-page of cbcg.me (24 siblings) already monitored at the parent level.
CRPI statutory disclosure repository gives dated, near-real-time board/management changes for listed ME banks.
